t.zh: 图像中的变化既可能沿水平方向出现，也可能沿竖直方向出现。要沿列应用<wiki-ref to="linear-filter"></wiki-ref>，需要读取哪些邻居？先在窗口中追踪一列，保持 x 不变、改变 y，再将读取方式用于整张图。 (<wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref>)
t.en: Changes in an image can run vertically as well as horizontally. Which neighbours are needed to apply a <wiki-ref to="linear-filter"></wiki-ref> down a column? Track one column in the window, keeping x fixed and varying y, then extend the addressing to the whole image. (<wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref>)

desc.zh: 输入一张图和上、中、下三个权重 a、b、c，输出和原图一样大：每个位置 a × 上邻 + b × 自己 + c × 下邻，图外补 0
desc.en: Takes an image and the above, centre and below weights a, b, c; gives an output as large as the image, a × above + b × here + c × below at each position, 0 outside

after.zh: 横向与纵向<wiki-ref to="linear-filter"></wiki-ref>使用相同的计算结构，区别在于邻居的位置。使用非方形图和不对称内容，有助于发现坐标方向混淆。
after.en: Horizontal and vertical <wiki-ref to="linear-filter"></wiki-ref> share the same computational structure but address different neighbours. Non-square images with asymmetric content help expose confusion between coordinate directions.

brief.zh: 使用上、中、下权重 [1,0,−1]，图外补零，写出每格结果。窗口可左右选择列、上下移动中心。 (<wiki-ref to="padding-border-rules"></wiki-ref>)
brief.en: Use above/centre/below weights [1,0,−1] with zero <wiki-ref to="padding-border-rules"></wiki-ref>. Write every result. Choose a column and move its centre vertically.

hint.zh: 比较同一列上、下的值；不能横向取邻居。
hint.en: Compare above and below in the same column, not horizontal neighbours.

why.zh: 这组数把每一对上下差都当成了 0。固定一列上下移动窗口，检查相邻数值并不相等的位置。
why.en: These values treat every above–below difference as zero. Keep one column fixed and move the window vertically to inspect unequal neighbours.

brief.zh: 输入一张图和权重 a、b、c：交出每个位置 a × 上邻 + b × 自己 + c × 下邻，图外补 0。
brief.en: Given an image and the weights a, b, c, give a × above + b × here + c × below at each position, 0 outside.

hint.zh: 和行滤波器比，变的是哪个坐标？
hint.en: Compared with the row filter, which coordinate changes?
